import '../AboutMeEdit/AboutMeEdit.css' import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux' import { editedProfile } from '../../../../../store/slices/UserSlice' export default function AboutMeEdit() { const profile = localStorage.getItem("userProfile") const handlerSubmit = async (e) => { const dispatch = useDispatch e.preventDefault() const [FirstName,LastName,Age,Bio,Location,Profession,Hobbies] = e.target const newUser = { id: profile.id, first_name: FirstName.value, last_name: LastName.value, age: Age.value, Bio: Bio.value, Location: Location.value, Profession: Profession.value, Hobbies: Hobbies.value, Image: profile.Image, } await fetch(`http://localhost:8000/api/upload`, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify(newUser), }) // dispatch(editedProfile(newUser)) e.target.reset() } return (
handlerSubmit(e)} >
) }
